featured_reviews.name: Amit Rajhans
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was looking to get a professional family photograph with my parents, and on a friend’s recommendation, I booked an appointment with Mr. Rajesh Chaddha at Indian Art Studio.

From the very first interaction, the experience was extremely professional. I truly appreciated how he took the time to clearly explain the entire process, making us feel at ease and well-informed.

The moment we entered the studio, we were in awe of the space. In fact, my father was so impressed that he wanted to photograph the studio itself :-)! The warmth and comfort that Mr. Rajesh Chaddha created for us is hard to put into words. It reflects not only his personal expertise but also the rich legacy of his family—being the fourth generation running this remarkable studio.

What started as a plan for one or two photographs turned into an extensive and memorable photoshoot. We ended up capturing many beautiful moments that we will cherish for years to come.

It’s incredible to experience a studio with over 100 years of history, still delivering such excellence and personal touch. Highly recommended for anyone looking for timeless, high-quality photography.

Highly recommended as their customer experience is at another level.

Keep the awesome work going and building value for your clients.

featured_reviews.name: PRATEEP BHADURI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Today, while carrying flowers back to my room, I happened to stop at Indian Art Studio, Kalbadevi, Mumbai. Earlier, one of the gentlemen at the Studio had invited me to visit, after noticing my curiosity towards the photographs displayed there. True to my word, I returned before catching the Metro and spent some time inside this remarkable establishment.
What I discovered was not merely a photography studio, but a living repository of memories, heritage and history. I had the privilege of meeting Shri. Sanjay Chaddha, one of the fourth-generation owners of this iconic studio. The very fact that the Studio continues to be run by the fourth generation speaks volumes about its legacy and commitment to preserving the art of photography.
The old black-and-white photographs, the carefully preserved colour portraits, and the timeless architecture of the Studio create an atmosphere that is difficult to describe in words. Every photograph appears to tell a story. Every frame seems to carry the memories, emotions and lives of people from another era. One cannot help but pause and reflect upon the passage of time.
What impressed me most was that Indian Art Studio has managed to preserve not only photographs but also a sense of nostalgia. The moment one steps inside, one is transported to a different period of Mumbai's history. In today's fast-changing world, such places are becoming increasingly rare.
For me, Indian Art Studio is not merely a business establishment. It is a temple of memories, heritage and human stories. Its architecture is as captivating as the photographs it houses, and together they create an experience that every lover of history, art, photography and old Mumbai should witness at least once.
I extend my heartfelt best wishes to Shri. Sanjay Chadda and the entire Chadda family for preserving this wonderful legacy. May Indian Art Studio continue to inspire future generations and remind us that photographs are not merely images—they are fragments of time preserved forever.
----Advocate Prateep Bhaduri.

featured_reviews.name: Hutoxi Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Ever since my father discovered Liberty Photo Arts decades ago, we have not needed to look anywhere else for any photography needs. Be it our college or office IDs, or passports and visa photos and tons of holiday trips photos, this family-run business, most conveniently located at 5 minutes walking distance from VT Station, Rajeshbhai did it all for my family for years, helped by loyal-till-today Jayantbhai. Those hundreds of photos are as vivid today as ever, precious unforgettable memories. Now his young son Devang is efficiently and enthusiastically carrying forward the business and it's a pleasure to see his smiling, kindly mother also sitting at the shop to help out. They are patient, hardworking and take a lot of trouble to be perfect till the customer is completely satisfied. Their rates are reasonable too. Two recent examples: 1.After the Covid-lockdown had eased and I needed some photos printed even though the shop was not open regularly, they made sure that the prints were delivered to me through neighbouring establishments, from where I could pick them up at my convenience. 2.Recently I wanted a print of an old picture on an ancient, rusty biscuit tin. 'Liberty' exceeded all my expectations and produced a wonderful copy after painstaking efforts and even framed it for me. In both these instances, Devang played a huge part in organising, corresponding and doing the needful with much patience, understanding and hard work. I surely commend Liberty Photo Arts to anyone for any photography needs anytime. Thank you 'Liberty'.

I had about 60 cassettes sitting untouched for almost three decades. Some of the tapes had even grown mold, and my father had completely lost hope that we’d ever be able to recover the footage.

After reading reviews, I decided to trust Digital Bell Colour Labs and send them our cassettes. Though I’ll admit, I was anxious and prepared for disappointment. But to my absolute surprise, Mr. Pankaj delivered… and how. Thanks to his special cleaning process, footage we never thought would see the light of day was beautifully retrieved. Moments we believed were lost forever are now safely preserved. The files were incredibly well organized, and the entire process was seamless from start to finish.

This is not just a service. Mr. Pankaj is truly in the business of restoring nostalgia and safeguarding priceless memories. I would trust him blindly. Thank you, Mr. Pankaj, you have given me and my family the gift of our past, something we will cherish for a lifetime.

featured_reviews.name: Rk Dhamdhere
featured_reviews.review_text:
I wanted to convert two of my old VCR cassettes into digital format. Unfortunately, one cassette was broken and the other had developed fungus. I had first approached another vendor at Lamington Road (which is well-known for electronics solutions), but they firmly said it was not possible to recover the data — and their charges were extremely high as well.
While searching on Google, I came across Digital Bell Colour Lab and connected with Pankaj Bhai. From the very first interaction, he was extremely polite, understanding, and reassuring. He didn’t just offer a solution — he genuinely understood the emotional value attached to those memories. He treated me like a family member and confidently assured me that he would try his best to repair and recover them.
What impressed me the most was that he did the entire work without asking for a single rupee in advance, which immediately built a lot of trust. And the result? Absolutely fantastic! He successfully repaired and converted the cassettes beyond my expectations.
Pankaj Bhai is truly a marvelous person with the right expertise and a very professional approach. I strongly recommend Digital Bell Colour Lab to anyone looking for reliable and heartfelt service.

featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 — Excellent Service for Converting Old VCR Tapes!

I recently used their service to convert my old VCR tapes to a pendrive, including my childhood birthday video and my parents’ 1989 wedding video. The quality came out amazingly well, and they handled the tapes with great care. These memories are very precious to me, and I’m really happy with the results.

The team was professional, quick, and kept me updated throughout the process. I highly recommend them to anyone who wants to preserve old memories in digital form!

name: Viren Desai Photography
description: Viren graduated with Highest Honours in 1985 with a Bachelor of Fine Arts degree in photography from THE ROCHESTER INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, moved back to Mumbai in 1987 and this is his 32nd year as a Professional Photographer. Campaigns include work done for Hero Honda, Concern India, Channel V, Visa, Tamara Capital, THE TAJ HOTELS, OSL P. Ltd, Directorate of Tourism, Pepsi, Hindustan Lever, Rosemount Computers, Soma Magazine, Bombay Dyeing, Tips & Toes etc. He is well known for his detailed and exquisite imagery of jewellery, working with some of the top brands like DIA, Lume’, Kantilal Chotalal, Ravindra Heraeus, etc. He published his dream project "The Grand Maestros of Indian Classical Music" in 2016, profiling 22 musicians
